797/*
798* A steering group defines a group members of which can have steering done
799* between them.
800* To remove a group configuration call this function with ap_cfgs as NULL, and length as 0.
801* @param[in] ctx BML Context.
802* @param[in] steeringGroupIndex Wifi Steering Group index
803* @param[in] ap_cfgs Array of AP Configurations
804* @param[in] length The number of AP Configuration in the array. Cannot be above 3.
805*
806* @return BML_RET_OK on success.
807*
808*/
809int bml_pre_association_steering_set_group(BML_CTX ctx, uint32_t steeringGroupIndex,
810 struct BML_STEERING_AP_CONFIG *ap_cfgs,
811 unsigned int length);
812
813/*
814* Call this function to add/modify/remove per-client configuration config of client_mac.
815* In order to remove a client configuration call with NULL as "config" parameter
816* or set config.snrProbeHWM to 0.
817* @param[in] steeringGroupIndex Wifi Steering Group index
818* @param[in] bssid AP bssid.
819* @param[in] client_mac The Client's MAC address.
820* @param[in] config The client configuration
821* @param[in] ctx BML Context.
822* @return BML_RET_OK on success.
823*
824*/
825int bml_pre_association_steering_client_set(BML_CTX ctx, uint32_t steeringGroupIndex,
826 const BML_MAC_ADDR bssid, const BML_MAC_ADDR client_mac,
827 struct BML_STEERING_CLIENT_CONFIG *config);
